facts.content: Investigation of 100 viral 'I make $10K/month with AI' claims found that only 12 held up upon checking proof and profit.
Building an app in 5 days using AI tools like Base44, implementing Stripe payments without code, and publishing with a custom domain.
Claimed revenue range for selling AI websites to local businesses using AI website builders.
Warning against course funnels and creators making money by selling access or communities rather than the actual claimed business model.
Shopify offers a 3-day free trial and AutoDS integration costs 99 cents to start.
Hobby rule triggered by IRS if a side hustle shows a loss in three out of five consecutive years.
Startup capital for basic AI tool stack is approximately $20 to $40 a month.
Payment apps have a reporting threshold of $20,000 and 200 transactions.
IRS error rate jumps to 55% for side hustlers and sole proprietors compared to 1% for W-2 employees.
facts.math: 55% error rate for side hustlers vs 1% for W-2

facts.content: Tool stack costs for advanced AI video generation workflows include approximately $120 a month for Google Flow and $20 a month for ChatGPT.
Platforms asking for money to apply, demanding excessive personal information without privacy policies, or promising guaranteed daily earnings are scam signals.
Local lead generation websites can be pitched to small business owners to help them rank higher on Google and collect customer info.
Shopify offers a 3-day free trial and AutoDS integration starting at 99 cents for e-commerce store automation.
Startup capital for building AI-assisted web apps and sites typically ranges from $20 to $40 a month in tool subscriptions.
Under IRS rules, side hustle income is any money earned outside a normal W2 paycheck for products or services, and payment apps have a $20,000 and 200 transaction threshold.

proposals.math: 100K views x $3.00/1000 (CR) = $300 or x $0.60 (Whop) = $60 per video (modeled); strong watch-time/comment engagement niche

proposals.stack: No-code AI app stack: AI app builder (Base44-class) + Stripe no-code + custom domain, ship paid web app in ~5 days (salvaged method, greenflag)

proposals.stack: AI niche-app subscription | Stack: Hostinger Horizons AI app builder (xYsafbVLJG4) -> single-purpose tool app -> monetize via subscription OR pay-per-use; ChatGPT for idea/feature spec. Distinct from local-site service (yesterday): product income, not service income.
proposals.math: Cost: ~$20-40/mo tools (ytAW1_g2IfI). Revenue: UNKNOWN - video gives no user numbers. Honest break-even: 6-10 paying users x $5/mo = $30-50/mo at ~$30/mo cost. Distribution is the bottleneck; treat as capped-cost experiment, not income.

proposals.stack: Fiverr AI digital-product gigs | Stack: ChatGPT + Canva -> resume templates, greeting cards, pet-portrait prompts, social captions (LiUwbBBAogE). Zero tech skills, $0 startup, fits existing sites as service.
proposals.math: Video claim (unverified): $300 first sale (resume templates). Conservative: 2-4 gigs/mo x $25-50 = $50-200/mo, scaling only with reviews. Flag: source plugs chaseswift.com affiliate tool (redflag); ramp is gated on Fiverr reviews (slow).

proposals.stack: Etsy AI print-on-demand | Stack: free AI image models (Google AI Studio/nano-banana, per 8NvhbfZNTrc) -> niche shirt designs -> Etsy POD (no inventory) + AI chatbot listing copy. Startup: $0.99 AutoDS trial option; otherwise just Etsy listing fees.
proposals.math: Video claim (unverified): $20/sale gross minus Etsy processing. Conservative: 30 sales/mo x $12 net = $360/mo (~1 sale/day, no ad spend). Reality-check (ymyir9dXjd8): POD is a real business but ads/product costs eat most of a $100k-revenue store. Flags: source sells "Ecom Clubhouse" course (redflag funnel).
